scope: All scientific aggregate fields from accepted full evaluation; raw per-position data and input manifests remain in the source report. This is an analysis export, not a goal completion certificate.

H2.limitation: Natural and injected premise/dependent revisions separate; conditional on observable opportunities.

H4.limitation: Two independent protocol lines averaged, not best-line selection.

H5.limitation: Unavailable secondary and failed contexts explicitly retained.

H6.limitation: Operational resources only; not total economic/energy/GPU efficiency.

primary.prediction_metric: Same ABC-identifiability target in every condition; a lucky single-source prediction can score here, not as verified knowledge.
primary.method: exact two-sided paired sign-flips; Holm over8;10000 stratified world bootstrap draws in final analysis
primary.assumption: sign-flip inference assumes symmetric paired differences under the null; not a randomized-label causal proof
